author: Bobby Grayson
description: Alternative encodings: a per-actor deferred list in the Actor structure (closer to BEAM's save queue) would keep Step.queue but change Config; rejected for now to keep all existing proofs intact.
title: Re-enqueue deferral spins under an unfair scheduler (tick bounces until the reply lands). Harmless for safety proofs, blows up bounded exploration depth, and would need a fairness assumption for liveness
